//: flow-hotfix.json — Track 0 极速通道（#hotfix / 微调：改动 <=3 文件、无 API/DB/类型契约变更）。
//usage: node .orca/flow.mjs --config flow-hotfix.json "#hotfix <问题描述与复现方式>"
//switch: 切换轨道：Track 0 (--config flow-hotfix.json) | Track 1 (默认 flow.config.json / --config flow-feature.json) | Track 2 (--config flow-epic.json)
//workflow: 完全跳过 PO / Backlog -> Red->Green 测试先行最小修复 -> 跨家族极速 Diff 审计 (Max Retry=2) -> 单测绿灯 + 提 PR 触发 CI（不直推/不自动合并 main）。
//modelNote: 默认 model 均为 "default"（沿用各 CLI 自身默认配置，可自由替换为任意闭源或开源模型）。下方为参考推荐组合，如需锁定模型将对应步骤的 model 改为实际模型 ID 即可。

//recommendedModelPool.hotfix-coding: 参考：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (High) 或 Gemini 4 Neon (Medium，禁止对 Carbon/Neon 开 Low)；也可换 Qwen/Claude/本地开源模型。
//recommendedModelPool.diff-audit: 参考：GPT-6.2 Sol (High，绝对不要开 Max)；核心原则是与编码模型跨家族隔离。
//recommendedModelPool.pr-submit: 参考：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Low) 或 Hy4 flash / Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium)。
//recommendedModelPool.ciFallback: 远端无头 CI 审 PR 推荐使用独立 API（如腾讯 TokenHub / 任意 OpenAI 兼容端点），严禁在 CI Runner 中使用个人订阅账号。

pipeline.title: Hotfix Red->Green Fix
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 0 (#hotfix) fast-path engineer. Skip PO/Backlog completely. Scope guard: keep changes <= 3 files with NO API/DB/TypeScript contract changes (if the issue actually requires contract changes or >3 files, stop and report outcome=failed recommending Track 1/2). FIRST ACTION - TASK CHECKLIST: write a concise Markdown checklist to {tasks} ('- [ ]' / '- [~]' / '- [x]') and keep it updated live. MANDATORY RED->GREEN WORKFLOW: (1) RED: write a minimal failing regression test that reproduces the exact bug and run it to confirm it FAILS for the expected reason; (2) GREEN: apply the smallest surgical code fix so the regression test and existing unit tests PASS; (3) run lint/typecheck/unit-test locally (stateless checks only). If re-run after a failed diff-audit, read HOTFIX_AUDIT.md and fix every BLOCKER/MAJOR finding. Write {out} with: root cause, red-test evidence, green-test evidence, changed files (<=3), and verification commands.

pipeline.title: Fast Diff Audit (Cross-Family)
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gpt-6.2-sol (effort: high; NEVER max) or any cross-family reviewer model
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 0 cross-family senior diff auditor. Inspect the git diff and {reads}. Verify strictly: (1) scope <= 3 files and zero contract changes; (2) genuine Red->Green regression test exists and passes; (3) no security regressions, side effects, or test-cheating. Write {out} with severity-grouped findings (BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR) and a clear VERDICT at the end: if any BLOCKER/MAJOR exists, report FAIL (outcome=failed) to loop back to hotfix-coding (hard cap Max Retry = 2); otherwise PASS. End {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL`.

pipeline.title: Unit Test Green & Open PR
